record.field: Transaction "%(transaction)s" and its invoice must belong to the same company.
Invoice "%(invoice)s" is not in %(currency)s: only invoices in the currency of the company can be paid by mobile.
Mobile payment account "%(account)s" has no Invoice Payment Method. Set it to pay invoices and sales by mobile.
Sale "%(sale)s" has no posted invoice waiting for payment. Create and post the invoice first.
Sale "%(sale)s" has several invoices waiting for payment. Open the invoice to pay and use "Pay by Mobile" there.
Invoice "%(invoice)s" is not a posted customer invoice: it cannot be paid by mobile.
Invoice "%(invoice)s" has nothing left to pay.
